question: Does January 2026 contain a physically admissible reciprocal specular geometry in which the fixed Love sky direction and the Moon are related by one of Khufu's four face/pyramidion normals, with the pyramid as the receiving interaction point?

site.name: Great Pyramid of Khufu
site.coordinate_note: Great-Pyramid center approximation; sub-km site uncertainty is negligible for this first angular gate.

khufu_geometry.orientation_source: Nell and Ruggles measured Khufu casing/foundation deviations from cardinality; values converted to outward face-normal azimuths.
khufu_geometry.surface_model: Four fixed triangular face normals; same normals are used for a hypothetical geometrically continuous pyramidion facet. No reflective material is assumed as historical fact.

physics.reciprocity_rule: Specular reflection is reversible: Moon -> facet -> Love and Love -> facet -> Moon satisfy the same normal-bisector condition.
physics.source_direction_vectors: s_moon and s_love point from pyramid facet toward the celestial source/target.
physics.visibility: Moon altitude > 0 deg AND Love altitude > 0 deg AND both lie in the outward hemisphere of the tested face.
physics.why_0_25_deg: Order-of-half-radius tolerance for the approximately half-degree apparent lunar disk; center-ray miss is still reported continuously.

blind_controls.primary: 999 deterministic RA-shift controls preserving Love declination; each control receives the same January search and four-face look-elsewhere opportunity.
blind_controls.admission: No directional special status unless the real Love target passes the geometric gate and outperforms controls.
